links.outcome: Note-active time, same-day and after-hours closures, note length, and wRVUs after AI scribe enrollment
links.effect: Note-active time fell 1.21 min (95% CI -1.74 to -0.68), and by 2.50 min among high users. No differences were seen in same-day closure, after-hours closure, or wRVUs. Note length increased among high users.
links.quote: Enrollment was not associated with improvements in same-day, after-hours note closures, or wRVUs.

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment of an ambient AI scribe (Heidi) across a 14-hospital health system on clinician workload and productivity, comparing high, low, and non-users without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
